pages.title: Starting
pages.text: $(li)Close the hatch and let the Vacuum Port pump the channel below 5%$(li)Cooldown: 20 kW for 2 minutes, half that in vacuum$(li)Ignition: 150 kW for 10 s$(li)Then it sustains itself

pages.title: Burning
pages.text: Drive sets the burn. Load-follow matches your grid's demand. Above 100% drive the First Wall wears.$(br2)Keep the Vacuum Port powered: without it, helium ash smothers the plasma.

pages.title: Stopping
pages.text: $(bold)Stop$() closes the fuel valve and ramps the burn down over 20 s, with no wear.$(br2)$(bold)E-Stop$(), held for a second, or a redstone signal ends the plasma at once: a disruption.

pages.title: Disruptions
pages.text: Disruptions: magnet power lost, the loop over 1,100°C, no fuel, the hatch opened or the shell broken while burning.$(br2)Each adds 5% wear to every First Wall block. Replace worn blocks to repair them; above 80% it will not ignite.
